owner_task_reference: Current GPoint Codex task: OWNER decision to switch Layer7 from Qwen/Ollama to native Eros Voyage 4 Lite, back up and restore-verify Eros DB, clear only known test vectors, verify Voyage query/document and new synthetic memory retrieval, then disable Ollama only after dependency and runtime checks.
task: Transition production GPoint/Eros v2.8.1 to native Voyage 4 Lite using the existing protected Native First release pipeline; preserve latest Deploy fixes and all unrelated data, accounts, personas, settings, schema, volumes and services.
acceptance_criteria: Current main and live runtime/database baselines match the exact recorded SHAs and component identities; no concurrent release or unexplained drift.
The current protected Eros backup is encrypted, integrity-checked, read back and restored to an isolated database before any deletion.

Only the OWNER-confirmed test vector rows in engine.companion_memories and engine.relationship_journal may be deleted; inbound-FK/trigger checks pass and every other table row count, account/persona/settings identity and schema signature is preserved.
Pinned Eros v2.8.1 uses the official native voyage-4-lite client at 512 dimensions; VOYAGE_API_KEY is stored root-owned mode 0600 and injected only into Eros.
Official Voyage query and document requests from the VPS pass with 512 finite dimensions and no secret output.
Existing workflow tests, immutable artifact/digest gates, SQLx backup/restore and migration parity, approval, lock, stock Kamal, Runtime Verify, rollback and smoke gates remain active.
A synthetic new Eros memory is written and retrieved after a context/session gap through the deployed Voyage configuration before Ollama is stopped.
Ollama is stopped only after code/config/runtime dependency checks prove no production consumer remains; preserve its volume and rollback artifacts through observation.
exclusions: No real-user data, account/persona/settings/schema changes, user routing/activation, DeepSeek changes, unrelated services, MAXIBOT, new workflow/controller/service, forced image/container/database deletion, database restore over production, force push or blind retry.
No deletion of histories, relationships, genomes, personas, accounts, settings or non-target tables.

release_infrastructure.risk_description: Owner explicitly authorized a production provider transition and conditional shutdown of the former embedding service. Release workflow changes are restricted to integrating that operation into existing Native First Deploy and preserving all current gates.
required_gates: protected Eros backup and isolated restore
synthetic memory persistence/recall before service retirement
release_infrastructure.backup_plan: Create a run-bound encrypted Eros PostgreSQL backup using existing gpoint-backup.agekey, verify ciphertext/read-back/integrity and restore into a uniquely named isolated DB. Preserve the backup; never restore over production automatically.
release_infrastructure.rollback_plan: Before Voyage memory verification, stop on failure and reconcile actual runtime. After approved test-memory cleanup, retain exact backup and old Qwen image/volume. Never switch Qwen onto Voyage vectors; any rollback must first use separately gated recovery on test-only data or remain blocked until compatible state is proven.
stop_conditions: any discovery of real-user data or Ollama dependency

production_secret.risk_description: Install only the existing owner-created Voyage API credential at /opt/gpoint/env/voyage.env, root-owned mode 0600; inject it only into the Eros engine process. Do not print, rotate, commit, or forward it to Core, Worker, Bot, Mini App or CI logs.
production_secret.backup_plan: Do not back up the secret into release artifacts; retain the already owner-managed source and verify metadata/presence only.
production_secret.rollback_plan: Keep the credential file for the rollback observation period; no rotation/deletion in this task.

test_memory_cleanup.risk_description: Remove only the exact OWNER-confirmed synthetic test vectors from two Eros memory tables after a verified backup and before any test-only new Voyage memory is written. The action must fail closed unless current counts match 476 companion_memories and 11 relationship_journal rows, all rows carry 512-dimensional vectors, and database identity/schema/FKs/triggers are unchanged.
required_gates: same-run encrypted backup and isolated restore PASS
expected row counts and embedding dimensions
no inbound FKs or delete triggers
one transaction deleting only the two named memory tables
verify all non-target table counts and schema signature unchanged
test_memory_cleanup.backup_plan: Existing protected Eros backup/isolated restore from this exact run, with ciphertext SHA-256 retained in the run evidence.
test_memory_cleanup.rollback_plan: No automatic production DB restore. Preserve immutable backup for separately gated recovery; if any unexpected count or state appears, stop before DELETE.
stop_conditions: new data appears during the guarded operation
